scientific limitations/integrity: The infinite contribution is the linear-index trichotomy. The deterministic uniqueness consequence is limited to \(k\le100\); no all-\(k\) uniqueness theorem is claimed. The \(q=5\) exceptional case is excluded. Factor completeness is taken from the cited Fibonacci factor table, whose index page states the first composite Fibonacci hole is \(F_{1423}\), while the largest index used here is \(196\).
title: Linear-index trichotomy for Fibonacci-totient witnessing primes
